The condition "divisible by some perfect cube greater than 1" is equivalent to "divisible by p³ for some prime p." So the answer is 999999 minus the number of cube-free integers in [1, 999999].

By Möbius inversion, the number of cube-free n ≤ N is

$$C(N)=\sum_{m\ge 1}\mu(m)\left\lfloor \frac{N}{m^3}\right\rfloor,\qquad N=999999,$$

where only squarefree m with m³ ≤ N (so m ≤ 99) contribute.

Summing the terms with μ(m) = +1 gives 1,006,707. Summing those with μ(m) = −1 gives 174,797. Therefore

$$C(999999)=1{,}006{,}707-174{,}797=831{,}910.$$

As a check, N/ζ(3) ≈ 999999/1.20206 ≈ 831,907, which agrees closely.

The number of integers in [1, 999999] divisible by some cube greater than 1 is

$$999999-831910=168089.$$

ANSWER: 168089
